title: DIO/ODI Semantic Change Feed
description: A curated, append-only record of documented semantic, structural, provenance, mapping, and artifact-state changes across the DIO/ODI reference system.

policy.correction_rule: Corrections are new events linked to earlier records; published event records are not silently overwritten.

events.title: MVDIO refines the analytical model of semantic vulnerability
events.summary: MVDIO separates Semantic Vulnerability from the Reconstruction Failure Mode hierarchy and develops K6 as a finer-grained candidate model.
events.before: The earlier Crisis-era account discussed Semantic Vulnerability in the broader field of reconstruction failures.
events.after: Semantic Vulnerability is treated as a robustness-related property outside the Reconstruction Failure Mode hierarchy; K6 is presented as a finer-grained candidate model.
preserved_invariants: K6 is a candidate model, not a logical consequence of MVDIO.
Identity Collapse remains distinct from the current Reconstruction Failure Modes.

impact.notes: Conceptual refinement; no exact source-control commit date is asserted.

evidence.temporal_note: Date is the registered publication date of MVDIO.

events.title: The Reconstruction Failure Modes taxonomy is formalized
events.summary: The Taxonomic Note develops the transition from entity-resolution anomalies to a hierarchical Reconstruction Failure Modes taxonomy, including Entity Substitution and Entity Omission.

scope.component: From Entity Resolution Anomalies to Reconstruction Failure Modes

events.before: The preceding corpus used an anomaly-oriented account of entity-resolution and reconstruction problems.
events.after: A multi-level Reconstruction Failure Modes taxonomy is documented, including Entity Substitution and Entity Omission; Semantic Robustness is also identified.
preserved_invariants: Semantic Vulnerability remains outside the Reconstruction Failure Mode hierarchy.
Identity Collapse is not folded into the taxonomy as a failure-mode superclass or equivalent.

impact.notes: Conceptual and taxonomic development; not an implementation or empirical-validation claim.

evidence.temporal_note: Date is the registered publication date of the Taxonomic Note.

events.title: Identity-Preserving Constraints becomes the collective vocabulary term
events.summary: Vocabulary v0.2.0 introduces the plural term Identity-Preserving Constraints as the current collective designation while retaining the singular entry as a historical concept.
events.before: The vocabulary contained the singular Identity-Preserving Constraint entry.
events.after: The plural Identity-Preserving Constraints is introduced as the current collective term in vocabulary v0.2.0.
preserved_invariants: The singular historical entry remains present.
Earlier singular URIs are not retroactively migrated.
No semantic relation between singular and plural entries is asserted.

impact.notes: Date identifies the first archived parent Reference Model release containing v0.2.0, not an exact edit timestamp.

evidence.temporal_note: The date is the publication date of archived Reference Model v0.2.0.

events.title: The RAG Application Mapping gains an iterative evidence-acquisition extension
events.summary: An iterative, hypothesis-conditioned evidence-acquisition extension is added to the derived RAG Pipeline mapping and first included in archived Reference Model v0.4.0.

scope.component: DIO Reconstruction Failure Modes × RAG Pipeline

events.before: The base mapping projected DIO Reconstruction Failure Modes to RAG pipeline loci, mechanisms, symptoms, and incidents.
events.after: The mapping additionally describes iterative and hypothesis-conditioned evidence acquisition.
preserved_invariants: The RAG mapping remains a derived, non-normative application layer.
The extension does not add or redefine canonical Reference Vocabulary concepts.

impact.notes: An application-mapping extension, not a change to the canonical vocabulary.

evidence.temporal_note: Date is the recorded first archival inclusion in Reference Model v0.4.0.

events.title: Reference Vocabulary v0.2.1 synchronizes vocabulary-level metadata
events.summary: Vocabulary v0.2.1 synchronizes creator identity, Dublin Core and namespace metadata, and DCAT/Schema.org descriptions across representations.
events.before: Vocabulary v0.2.0 carried the preceding metadata graph and representation state.
events.after: Vocabulary v0.2.1 uses the canonical Person URI and synchronizes creator, license, issue/modification, language, namespace, FOAF, DCAT 3, and Schema.org Dataset metadata.
preserved_invariants: All 40 SKOS concepts, URIs, labels, definitions, notes, hierarchy, and provenance statements are preserved.
The historical status of Entity Resolution Anomaly is unchanged.
Archived Reference Model v0.6.0 remains an immutable snapshot containing vocabulary v0.2.0.

impact.notes: Explicitly described as a metadata-only maintenance update; no concept-level semantic change is claimed.

evidence.temporal_note: Date is the stated release date of vocabulary v0.2.1.

events.title: Agentic ER mapping v0.3.1 synchronizes provenance with arXiv v2
events.summary: The live Agentic ER Architecture Mapping synchronizes provenance to the public arXiv v2 manuscript. The change is provenance-only; its concept and relation inventories remain unchanged.

scope.component: Constraining the Commit Boundary, arXiv v2

events.before: Mapping v0.3.0 was aligned to production manuscript v55 and included in archived Reference Model v0.6.0.
events.after: Mapping v0.3.1 synchronizes provenance and source anchors with arXiv v2 and is included in archived Reference Model v0.7.0.
preserved_invariants: The mapping retains 120 local architecture concepts.
The mapping retains 206 qualified relation assertions.
The mapping remains derived and non-normative; canonical vocabulary is unchanged.

impact.notes: The registry explicitly characterizes v0.3.1 as a provenance-only synchronization.

evidence.temporal_note: Date is the arXiv v2 version date recorded in the corpus registry.

events.title: Reference Model v0.7.0 preserves a new versioned corpus snapshot
events.summary: Reference Model v0.7.0 is archived on Zenodo as a versioned research-software package. Its component state includes Reference Vocabulary v0.2.1 and Agentic ER mapping v0.3.1.
events.before: The preceding archived package was v0.6.0, containing vocabulary v0.2.0 and Agentic ER mapping v0.3.0.
events.after: A new immutable v0.7.0 package snapshot is published, recording vocabulary v0.2.1 and Agentic ER mapping v0.3.1.
preserved_invariants: Earlier archived releases remain identifiable and are not silently rewritten.
An archive is a versioned package snapshot, not itself evidence of a new theoretical claim.

impact.notes: Artifact and distribution history only; component-level semantic changes are recorded separately.

evidence.temporal_note: Date is the recorded Zenodo publication date for Reference Model v0.7.0.
